app.title: Modu Interviewer
app.tagline: Mock interviews built from your resume
start.headline: Practice interviews like the real thing
start.sub: Add your resume, portfolio and the job posting. A panel will question you on them, react with their faces, and hand you a full report at the end.
start.f1d: "You wrote 20x growth…" — questions grounded in your documents
start.f2d: Nods, smiles, head tilts, frowns. Pick a pressure interviewer too
start.f3: A report with a hiring verdict
start.f3d: Scores per criterion, rewritten answers, questions for next time
prep.title: Preparation
prep.name: Your name (optional · used only to mask it, never sent)
prep.paste: Paste here or upload a file (PDF, DOCX, TXT up to 10MB)
prep.scanned: We found almost no text. If this is a scanned PDF, please paste the text instead.
prep.privacy1: Your documents and answers are not stored on our server. They are used only to generate questions and scores, then discarded.
prep.privacy2: Emails, phone numbers, addresses, ID numbers and your name are masked before sending. You can edit the text above.
prep.privacy3: We use free AI models whose providers may use inputs for training. Please leave out anything sensitive.
prep.need: Please fill in the company, job posting and resume
panel.title: Interviewers & format
panel.practiceD: See the score card and a rewritten answer right away
panel.realD: Only facial reactions during the interview
panel.voiceD: Uses your browser's voice. Text is the default
quota.device: You've used today's free interviews on this device ({n} per day). Come back after midnight KST.
quota.global: Today's free interviews are all taken. New slots open at midnight KST.
quota.error: Couldn't start. Please try again shortly.
room.reviewing: The panel is reviewing your documents…
room.basicPlan: AI is busy, so we're using the standard question set.
room.placeholder: Type your answer. Ctrl+Enter to submit
room.micNote: Depending on your browser, audio may be sent to its speech service.
room.icebreakReply: Yes, it was fine, thank you
room.endConfirm: Create the report from your answers so far?
room.closing: That's all for today. Thank you for your time.
room.intro: Hello, we are {names}. Thanks for coming in — please make yourself comfortable.
card.localD: AI was unavailable, so this was scored by rules
report.title: Interview report
report.thanks: Thanks! We'll use this to improve.
report.local: Basic report (AI unavailable, built from score totals)
panel.turnstileError: Bot check failed (code {code}). Try disabling ad blockers or reloading. If it persists, the site owner must add this domain to the Turnstile widget.
